- - Fix upscale channel count, Regex Find no-match type, and node input bugs ([#3345](https://github.com/chaiNNer-org/chaiNNer/pull/3345)) by [@joeyballentine](https://github.com/joeyballentine)

- - Bump http-cache-semantics from 4.1.1 to 4.3.0 in the npm-security group across 1 directory ([#3340](https://github.com/chaiNNer-org/chaiNNer/pull/3340)) by [@dependabot](https://github.com/dependabot)[bot]

- - Bump npm dependencies ([#3336](https://github.com/chaiNNer-org/chaiNNer/pull/3336)) by [@joeyballentine](https://github.com/joeyballentine)
- - Revert the experimental executor and sequence transformer/collector nodes ([#3333](https://github.com/chaiNNer-org/chaiNNer/pull/3333)) by [@joeyballentine](https://github.com/joeyballentine)
- - Upgrade dependency versions ([#3316](https://github.com/chaiNNer-org/chaiNNer/pull/3316)) by [@joeyballentine](https://github.com/joeyballentine)
